versions.changelog: Skip account, billing, and credential onboarding when an AudioFlow environment or stored credential is already configured.
Rebrand to AudioFlow, rename credential variables, add account and prepaid-credit prerequisites, and refresh the demo.
Clarify that transcripts can be used for summaries, content questions, and information extraction when explicitly requested.
Classify the skill under Creative and Productivity while preserving its transcription, audio, video, podcast, and subtitles topics.
Clarify that VoiceFlow deletes uploaded media immediately after transcription reaches a terminal state, with bounded private-storage lifecycle cleanup as a fallback.
Require explicit per-run approval before remote ASR uploads, managed yt-dlp downloads, or FFmpeg installation.
Replace Chinese catalog metadata and the Xiaoyuzhou reference with English for English-speaking users.
Initial release: caption-first transcription for local media, public videos, and podcast episodes.
